// Board-side construction of U8G2_SSD1306_128X64_NONAME_F_HW_I2C for target 'portrait'.
// A starting point for your firmware's board file (e.g. board.h), not
// generated code: U8G2GL describes the panel; the pins and bus are your board's.

#include <U8g2lib.h>
#include "ui.hpp"  // generated by u8g2gl, in the project's output directory

// Replace each FILL_IN_PIN with your board's pin; the build stops until you do.
#define DISPLAY_RESET FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's RESET, or U8X8_PIN_NONE (U8G2's default)
#define DISPLAY_CLOCK FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's CLOCK, or U8X8_PIN_NONE (U8G2's default)
#define DISPLAY_DATA  FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's DATA, or U8X8_PIN_NONE (U8G2's default)

// U8G2GL_TARGET_ROTATION comes from ui.hpp; at this target's rotation it is U8G2_R1.
U8G2_SSD1306_128X64_NONAME_F_HW_I2C display(U8G2GL_TARGET_ROTATION, DISPLAY_RESET, DISPLAY_CLOCK, DISPLAY_DATA);

void setup() {
    // U8G2 can't know your panel's I2C address. If it isn't U8G2's default,
    // set it before begin(), in U8G2's 8-bit form (the 7-bit address * 2):
    // display.setI2CAddress(0x3C * 2);
    display.begin();
    if (!ui_display_matches(display)) {
        /* the panel or rotation differs from target 'portrait' */
    }
    ui_init();
}
